thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm going to tweak payments-sts to reduce replica count and change the rollout strategy to PartitionedRollingUpdate to make rolling restarts less noisy. Plan: replicas 5 -> 3, updateStrategy.partition: 1, lower cpu limit from 1 -> 700m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 :eyes:
maria: @alex curious why partitioned vs maxUnavailable? won't partitioning leave older pods up longer and cause double-writes for a bit?
jamal: Partitioned gives us tighter control of how many pods get replaced at once; with statefulset PVs we also avoid node churn. But double-writes are app-level — do we have leader election?
alex: payments uses leader lock in Redis, so two replicas briefly serving is ok. primary writes guarded. main reason is to avoid thundering reconnections to 3rd-party payment gateway during full rolling update.
tera: Dropping replicas from 5->3 changes capacity for batch jobs — do we run any cron pods against payments-sts?
jamal: Not directly. Batch workers hit payments-api, not sts. But autoscaler config might be sensitive if HPA targets are low.
tera: OK. I ran a quick kube-sim with the new config and readiness probes looked stable. Sharing the relevant snippet from the PR for context:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: payments-sts
spec:
  replicas: 3
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: payments
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "700m"
            memory: "1Gi"
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/ready
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 3
```
alex: Also added a terraform var change in infra/terrraform/k8s/sts.tf to set replicas = var.payments_replicas. Example change in the PR:
```
variable "payments_replicas" {
  type = number
  default = 3
}
```
maria: Two practical asks: 1) can we add a preStop hook to drain connections before pod termination? 2) add a brief note in the rollout runbook about gateway rate-limits so oncall knows to watch external 429s.
jamal: +1 to preStop. Suggest `sleep 10` after `curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/_drain` so existing traffic drains.
tera: I'll add the preStop and update the runbook in the same PR. Also adding a canary label so we can do a controlled rollout: set `kubectl patch sts payments-sts --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"replicas":2}}'` in the canary job before full apply.
alex: Nice. One more wiring check — secrets: payments uses a rotated API key in k8s secret `payments-gateway-key`. This PR doesn't touch that, but confirm we don't recreate the secret.
maria: Confirmed — I checked the terraform plan, no changes to that secret resource.
deploy-bot: infra/ci — PR #482: plan OK, 3 checks passed, 1 warning (resource quota).
alex: Sounds like consensus. I'll merge after tera's preStop + runbook update and then coordinate a low-traffic window for rollout. Thanks all :thumbsup:
maria: FYI — I'll watch monitoring (gateway 5xx and our request latencies) and have oncall ready for the 2-hour window.
jamal: If anything looks off we can pause by scaling back replicas to previous count and rollback the statefulset partition.
tera: PR updated with preStop + runbook link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482/files — ready for merge from my side.
alex: Merging in 10m unless objections. :rocket:
